name: SimVox eSIM Integration
author: simvox

sections.description:
Integrate SimVox eSIM products with WooCommerce, allowing customers to purchase and activate data packages for travel.

SimVox eSIM Integration connects your WooCommerce store to SimVox, allowing customers to easily purchase and activate eSIM data packages for travel. Features include automatic product syncing, instant eSIM activation, and seamless integration with your customers’ dashboards.

Whether you’re running an online travel shop or offering connectivity services, SimVox simplifies global data access—directly from your WooCommerce store.

Online Anywhere

Introducing SimVox, your gateway to seamless internet connectivity through advanced eSIM technology. Enjoy reliable, high-speed access anywhere in the world—whether you’re traveling for business, leisure, or living abroad. SimVox keeps you connected wherever life takes you.

Designed for modern travelers, digital nomads, and frequent flyers, SimVox’s eSIM technology makes staying online effortless. Stream without buffering, hold video calls with confidence, and browse freely—whether you’re on a business trip, a vacation, or working remotely.

With transparent pricing, flexible data plans, and no hidden fees, SimVox offers a stress-free, easy-to-use solution for staying connected.

Stay connected, stay productive, and explore the world with ease.

What Is SimVox for Business?

SimVox for Business elevates your operations with cutting-edge eSIM solutions designed for global teams. Whether you’re managing remote workers or frequently traveling, our reliable, high-speed connectivity ensures your team stays productive and connected—anywhere, anytime.

Simplify communication, streamline logistics, and reduce costs with flexible and scalable connectivity plans.

SimVox empowers businesses to operate smoothly and efficiently, so you can focus on growth—not connectivity.

Features

  • Seamless integration with WooCommerce
  • Automatic product synchronization from SimVox
  • eSIM activation upon order completion
  • Customized order emails with eSIM details
  • Customer dashboard integration for order status
  • Support for multiple countries and data packages

Usage

Configuration

  1. Go to SimVox in your WordPress admin
  2. Enter your SimVox API key
  3. Click “Save Settings”

Product Management

  • Products are automatically synced from SimVox.
  • Each product represents a data package with specific:
    • Country
    • Data amount
    • Duration
    • Price

Customer Purchase Flow

  1. Customer selects a data package.
  2. Completes the checkout process.
  3. Upon payment completion, the eSIM is automatically activated.
  4. Customer receives an email with eSIM details, including QR code.
  5. Customer can view order status and eSIM info in their account dashboard.

External Services

This plugin relies on the following third-party external services:

1. GOQR.me API

  • What it is: GOQR.me provides a free API for generating QR codes.
  • What it is used for: This plugin uses the GOQR.me API to generate QR codes that contain the eSIM activation code. These QR codes are displayed to users for easy scanning and activation of their eSIM.
  • What data is sent and when: When a QR code is generated, only the eSIM activation code is sent to the GOQR.me API endpoint to encode it into a QR code image. No other personal, user, or site data is transmitted.
  • Terms of Service: GOQR.me Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy: GOQR.me Privacy Policy

2. Google Chart API

  • What it is: The Google Chart API is a free service by Google for generating charts and QR codes.
  • What it is used for: This plugin uses the Google Chart API to generate QR codes that contain the eSIM activation code as an alternative to GOQR.me.
  • What data is sent and when: When a QR code is generated, only the eSIM activation code is sent to the Google Chart API endpoint to create the QR code image. No other personal, user, or site data is transmitted.
  • Terms of Service: Google Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy: Google Privacy Policy

Note: By using this plugin, you acknowledge that the eSIM activation code will be sent to these third-party services for the sole purpose of generating the required QR code.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/simvox directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the SimVox menu in your WordPress admin to configure your API key and settings.
sections.faq:
Do I need a SimVox account?

Yes, you need a SimVox account and API key.

Is WooCommerce required?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Can I use local or CDN libraries?

Yes, you can choose in the plugin settings whether to load Select2/Isotope from a CDN or use local copies.
